input.rationale: There is no inbound licence to us that is revocable or scope-limited: this Co-Development Agreement gives PB (our party) rights to the relevant IP by ownership rather than licence — PB retains all Existing PB Intellectual Property (11.1.1.1), is exclusive owner of all Trial Inventions with SFJ assigning and causing its Affiliates and Permitted Third Parties to assign (11.1.1.3(a)-(b)), and acquires sole ownership of the Trial Data Package and Research Results (11.1.1.4). Where assignment cannot be obtained from SFJ's consultants or Third Party contractors, SFJ must instead procure for PB a worldwide, royalty-free, fully-paid, freely-assignable licence with the right to sublicense through multiple tiers (11.1.1.3(b)-(c)) — irrevocable in substance, transferable to successors, and extendable to our Affiliates and contractors via the sublicence right. That meets or exceeds the preferred position, so no redline is warranted. The only grant in the other direction (11.1.1.6 "No Other Rights") is protective of us, limiting SFJ to what is necessary to perform, and the Program Transfer grant sits in the Exhibit O form outside this text. We note only as sub-elements that the contractor licences are obtained on a commercially reasonable efforts basis with a carve-out in 11.1.1.3(c) for contractor background/improvement technology, and that the AZ License prevails over conflicting terms.
